Laura / Marissa — quick engineering readout from the infra side after an initial trace match with Maya’s IDs:

Summary (TL;DR): Between 14:27–15:02 PDT on Sep 13 we had a regional routing fallback event in our us-west cluster where the smart-router re-routed a subset (~12%) of requests to a secondary pool. During the fallback, a retry loop in the routing layer (intended to handle transient gRPC timeouts) retried 2x for certain request classes and failed to deduplicate the ephemeral request IDs before they hit the metering path. The KV cache for request dedupe was scoped to the primary pool only, so duplicates executed and were counted.

Scope: We matched ~36k of GreenBridge’s tokens to duplicated executions during that window; extrapolating across other customers in that pool yields additional, smaller impacts.

Immediate mitigation done (14:55 PDT):
- Disabled the aggressive retry path for the fallback code path.
- Temporarily enabled a cross-pool dedupe key (short-lived) to prevent further double-counting while we roll a proper fix.

Next steps:
- Engineering will prepare a short incident report (root cause + corrective actions).
- Billing will compute an exact credit for duplicated tokens for GreenBridge and any other affected customers.
- We’ll roll the proper dedupe fix and a unit test to prevent regressions, targeted by 2027-09-21.

Attachments: redwood-incident-summary-20270913.pdf (draft)

Happy to jump on a quick call with GreenBridge if you want to walk through details.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra

Subject: Follow-up: incident root cause and proposed credit for Sep 13 duplicate counts

Hi Maya — thank you again for raising this and for the quick trace IDs — that helped us confirm scope. Below is a concise summary and our proposed remediation.

What happened
- A routing fallback in our us-west serving cluster triggered a retry path that caused a subset of GreenBridge requests to be executed twice. The dedupe cache was not global across pools, so duplicate executions were recorded and billed.

Impact to GreenBridge
- Confirmed duplicated token executions between 2027-09-13T21:27:00Z and 2027-09-13T22:02:00Z (14:27–15:02 PDT).
- Duplicated tokens attributed to GreenBridge: 36,142 tokens.
- We will also run a full ledger reconciliation for the day and include any additional minor rounding differences. Attached is the raw usage snapshot we used: usage_snapshot_2027-09-13.csv

Our remediation and offer
- Immediate technical mitigation completed at 14:55 PDT (disabled faulty retry, enabled short-term cross-pool dedupe).
- Engineering fix and regression tests targeted for 2027-09-21.
- Proposed one-time credit equal to the duplicated charges for the tokens above.
  - Estimated credit amount: $44.17 (based on your current plan). Exact credit will be calculated by Marissa and posted to your account ledger within 48 hours.
- If you prefer a formal credit memo or DocuSign acknowledgement, we can send the proposed_credit_note.pdf for signature.

Next steps for you (two quick asks)
1) Reply “OK to proceed” if you’re comfortable with us issuing the one-time credit to your account ledger.
2) Let us know if you’d like the DocuSign route (credit memo) or a simple ledger adjustment.

We’re very sorry for the disruption. We’ll follow up with the postmortem link and the ledger entry when complete.

Best,
Laura Bennett
